_comment: The source inventory for the knowledge base.
`id`     stable slug, used for the folder name and every piece id
`track`  the primary learning track — decides the folder it lands in
`tier`   free | premium — premium drops are priced in USDT between 5 and 10
`attribution` what has to be credited if the piece is republished
